summary: Add assumptions field to Decision type for assumption-based validation in assemble output
context: Benchmark showed agents get decisions via assemble but interpret them independently, leading to inconsistent implementations. shared-markdown agents copy concrete patterns while Twining agents get abstract summaries.
rationale: Explicit assumptions let formatForLLM be prescriptive when assumptions hold ('follow exactly') and advisory when they don't ('reconsider'). This bridges the gap between structured decision records and actionable implementation guidance.

alternatives.option: Add implementation_hints field with concrete code patterns
alternatives.reason_rejected: Couples decisions to specific implementations; assumptions are more durable and let agents validate whether the decision still applies

alternatives.option: No change — rely on rationale text for context
alternatives.reason_rejected: Rationale explains why but doesn't tell agents when to deviate. Agents currently follow decisions even when underlying assumptions have changed.
